title: FOUR DAY - LEGS/ARMS + TORSO/SHOULDERS
author: Toru Okada
desc: This program alternates between legs/arms and torso/shoulders. Generally, volume is lower than comparable programs, so Intensity should be kept high - focus on making the most of the sets. Can (and should) be tweaked to your individual goals.

ex.note: Aim is warm up knees and get a Hamstring pump.
Any squat variation. Focus on full rom, slight pause.
Any Lunge variation. Focus on control and full rom.
Control, full rom. Focus on warming the elbows and getting a pump.
DB or cable. Focus on warming elbows and getting a pump.
Strength focus, heavy weight.
Ezbar or DB. Strength focus, heavy weight.
Barbell or DB. Slight pause on chest. 5-15 reps.
Control the weight, deep stretch at top.
Focus on chest, deep stretch.
Solid squeeze and stretch.
High effort, choose an appropriate weight. Avoid traps overtaking.
Lighter weight, control and squeeze. Avoid traps/upper back overtaking.
Raise legs by squeezing core. Control on the way down.
Aiming to warm up knees and get a pump.
